run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-17T06:02:08Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is explained by the total absence of an Alertmanager in this cluster: no Alertmanager Pod, StatefulSet, Deployment, Service, Endpoint, ConfigMap or ServiceAccount exists in namespace prometheus or anywhere else, although the Alertmanager CRD (alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com, v1) is installed. Prometheus therefore has no Alertmanager to discover, which is exactly the condition PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers reports. The alerting instance 100.96.5.74:9090 is the running, ready pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 (started 2026-11-17T06:01:36Z, restartCount 0); its 06:01:36Z pod recreation was not a template rollout (StatefulSet generation 1, currentRevision == updateRevision) and cannot by itself explain the condition, since nothing resembling an Alertmanager exists in the cluster now. Whether the kube-prometheus-stack release 'prometheus' was installed without the Alertmanager (most consistent with the also-absent Alertmanager ServiceAccount/RBAC/config) or Alertmanager objects were removed shortly before the alert (change history is not integrated and events only exist from 06:09:28Z) cannot be determined from the available sources. The alert's own metric and rule are not observable here: the registered Prometheus holds only otel-demo-scoped series and no prometheus_* self-metrics or rules. No evidence of application impact was observed, and no node, crash, eviction or network cause is supported.

claims.text: The instance in the alert, 100.96.5.74:9090, is pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 in namespace prometheus: status.podIP is 100.96.5.74, phase Running, all containers ready with restartCount 0, startTime 2026-11-17T06:01:36Z, owned by StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.

A complete enumeration of namespace prometheus returned 8 pods only: prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0, prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh, prometheus-kube-state-metrics-7c5fb9d798-tqssx and five prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter pods. No pod belongs to an Alertmanager.

The cluster-wide StatefulSet enumeration (6 items, complete) contains no Alertmanager StatefulSet; the only StatefulSet in namespace prometheus is prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (spec.replicas 1, status.readyReplicas 1).

The cluster-wide Deployment enumeration (36 items, complete) contains no Alertmanager Deployment; namespace prometheus has only prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator (prometheus-operator v0.85.0) and prometheus-kube-state-metrics (v2.17.0), both 1/1 available.

All 5 Services and all 5 Endpoints in namespace prometheus belong to prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (http-web 9090), prometheus-operated, prometheus-kube-state-metrics and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter. There is no Alertmanager Service and no Alertmanager Endpoint, so no Alertmanager address exists for Prometheus to send to.
The only ConfigMaps in namespace prometheus are kube-root-ca.crt and prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 (rule files only); there is no Alertmanager configuration ConfigMap.

The 5 ServiceAccounts in namespace prometheus are default, prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, prometheus-kube-state-metrics and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter; the chart-managed ones carry managed-by Helm and release=prometheus labels, and none is an Alertmanager service account.

The Alertmanager API is installed: customresourcedefinitions include alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com (group monitoring.coreos.com, kind Alertmanager, version v1, created 2026-11-16T06:47:55Z), alongside the AlertmanagerConfig, Prometheus and PrometheusRule CRDs, while no Alertmanager workload or object of that kind is visible in the cluster.

Prometheus StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus has metadata.generation 1, currentRevision and updateRevision both prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59, updatedReplicas 1 and ready 1, and mounts its generated config from a secret volume plus the rulefiles ConfigMap; the pod running since 06:01:36Z is therefore not the result of a StatefulSet template rollout.

All 5 cluster nodes are Ready with Ready lastTransitionTime 2026-11-12T16:33-16:34Z and 2026-11-13T08:37:20Z (no node was created near the incident), and the grouped cluster-wide events (26 kind/namespace/reason groups, spanning 2026-11-17T06:09:28Z to 06:42:14Z) contain no event whose involvedObject.namespace is prometheus.

The registered Prometheus target does not expose the alert's own series: enumerating every metric name in the window returned 63 names (complete) with none prefixed prometheus_ and none named up or scrape_*, and the namespace label values of container_cpu_usage_seconds_total are only [otel-demo].

Primary hypothesis: Prometheus reports zero discovered Alertmanagers because the kube-prometheus-stack release 'prometheus' was deployed without the Alertmanager component (no Alertmanager CR and no alertmanager subchart objects), so its generated alerting configuration has no Alertmanager target and prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered stays below 1. This is consistent with every alertmanager artifact being absent while the other subcharts' ServiceAccounts/Deployments/StatefulSet/Services carry the same release=prometheus Helm labels.

Alternative timing hypothesis: Alertmanager objects may have existed earlier and been removed, or the Prometheus alerting configuration changed, shortly before the alert fired (the alert begins 2026-11-17T06:02:08Z, about 10 minutes before which a 'less than 1 discovered Alertmanager' condition would have started if the rule carries a 10m for clause). This cannot be verified: the change-history integration is not available, retained events start only at 06:09:28Z, and the generated Prometheus config secret is redacted.

Alternative configuration hypothesis: the Prometheus custom resource (prometheuses.monitoring.coreos.com/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus) may carry an alerting.alertmanagers selection that matches no existing Alertmanager object (for example a name/namespace/selector that is not deployed), which would produce the same zero-discovery condition. The Prometheus and Alertmanager custom resources of kinds not readable by these tools, so this remains unverified.

Rejected as the cause: the Prometheus pod's recreation at 2026-11-17T06:01:36Z. The StatefulSet revision is unchanged (generation 1, currentRevision == updateRevision), the pod reports restartCount 0, and no Alertmanager workload exists anywhere in the cluster for a restarted Prometheus to reconnect to, so a restart mechanism cannot account for 'not connected to any Alertmanagers'.

Rejected as the cause: a Service/Endpoint misconfiguration or connection refusal between Prometheus and Alertmanager. The complete endpoint enumeration of namespace prometheus shows no Alertmanager endpoint at all (only operator, prometheus http-web 9090, prometheus-operated, kube-state-metrics and node-exporter), so there is no target whose connectivity could be refused or misrouted.

Checked and found healthy within this alert's scope: the Prometheus pod is Running and ready with restartCount 0 and empty lastState, the prometheus-operator and kube-state-metrics deployments are 1/1 available, all five nodes are Ready since 2026-11-12/2026-11-13, and all 36 enumerated deployments report ready replicas equal to spec.replicas. No crash, eviction, evicted-pod or node failure signature was observed in the monitoring namespace.

Verify and, if alerting is intended, restore the Alertmanager component for the 'prometheus' release: inspect the Helm release values (alertmanager.enabled and prometheus.prometheusSpec.alerting.alertmanagers) and the objects kubectl -n prometheus get alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com,prometheuses.monitoring.coreos.com -o yaml, then deploy/enable the Alertmanager custom resource so Prometheus's generated alerting config points at a live Alertmanager service.

Confirm the fix from the firing Prometheus itself rather than the registered store: check that prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered is at least 1 and that prometheus_target_sync_length_seconds or the alerting section of the generated config contains the Alertmanager target, and re-check that PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers clears in Alertmanager.

gaps: The alert's underlying series prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered is not observable in the registered Prometheus: get_metric_names for {__name__=~"prometheus_notifications.*"} returned nothing (no_data view), and the store holds only otel-demo-scoped application/cAdvisor series (63 names, none prometheus_*), so the metric value could not be read.

The alerting rule itself is not visible: list_prometheus_rules filtered by rule_name=PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers returned nothing (no_data), and an unfiltered list_prometheus_rules returned no rule groups at all (no_data), so the rule's exact expression and its for duration (which would date the onset of the condition) are unknown.

The Prometheus custom resource (prometheuses.monitoring.coreos.com/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus) and any Alertmanager custom resource are not readable with the available Kubernetes kinds, and the generated Prometheus configuration Secret is redacted, so it could not be verified whether spec.alerting.alertmanagers is empty or references a non-existent Alertmanager.

Change history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so it is unknown whether Alertmanager objects ever existed in namespace prometheus and were removed before the alert, or whether the release was installed without them.

Pod logs could not be obtained at all: fetch_pod_logs returned zero lines for all three containers of prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and also for the running otel-demo pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-2psc4 (both no_data views), so no log evidence exists for Prometheus's alertmanager discovery or for the pod recreation.

Events are retained only from 2026-11-17T06:09:28Z to 06:42:14Z and contain no events for namespace prometheus, so the cause of the Prometheus pod recreation at 2026-11-17T06:01:36Z (and the fate of its previous instance, whose logs are unavailable) is unknown and remains an unexplained change during the window.

Queries for RoleBindings (namespace prometheus), NetworkPolicies (cluster-wide), ResourceQuotas (namespace prometheus) and for alertmanager-named ServiceAccounts/Roles/ClusterRoles/RoleBindings returned no rows (no_data views), so RBAC, egress-policy and quota state could not be asserted either way.

Whether any alert notification delivery is currently expected downstream (for example by the data-recorders prometheus-alert-recorder StatefulSet) is unverified; no Alertmanager receiver object was observed.
next_steps: Run 'helm get values prometheus -n prometheus' (or inspect the Helm release secret through an authorized operator) to confirm alertmanager.enabled and prometheus.prometheusSpec.alerting.alertmanagers for the kube-prometheus-stack release.
Inspect the Alertmanager and Prometheus custom resources: kubectl -n prometheus get alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com,prometheuses.monitoring.coreos.com -o yaml.
Inspect the generated Prometheus config (Secret prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus in namespace prometheus) for an 'alerting:' block with alertmanagers entries.

If alerting is required, enable/deploy the Alertmanager for this release and then verify prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered >= 1 and that the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers alert clears.
Add retention or an event archive for namespace prometheus and enable pod log collection so that future pod recreations and configuration changes in the monitoring namespace can be diagnosed.
